outline.h2: Why November works for a destination wedding
outline.answers: PAA (New York, both queries): 'Is November a good wedding month?'; Vogue Ballroom (Melbourne #7) frames November as an off-season window
outline.notes: Honest answer in two halves: late autumn in Europe (cooler, wetter, some venues closing) and spring or early summer in the south, where several tropical places enter their wet or cyclone season. No weather numbers here. Never 'best time'.

outline.h2: How we chose these ten November destinations
outline.answers: Must-include from 00-input: unranked, only places with a live guide of ours, official weather only
outline.notes: One short paragraph. Say the list is unranked and that trade-offs are stated plainly.

outline.answers: Secondary 'november wedding destinations'; SERP angle 'autumn/fall wedding destinations' (Melbourne, Sydney); must-include group 1 in 01-brief
outline.notes: Matches 01-brief group 1. Late season in Europe: our Italy best-time page says many coastal and lakeside venues close for winter; our Amalfi page gives late April to June and September to early October; our France page says the South of France runs May to October; our Portugal page says May to early October. So 'is the venue open in November' is a venue question in every European entry, never closing dates. Hawaii said plainly to be northern tropics (our Hawaii page: winter October to April, heavier rain). Weather via planner-sme batch nv_a (WMO Naples 604, Nice 902, Lisbon 2; HNMS Naxos) and NWS Hawaii.

outline.h2: Spring and early summer in the southern hemisphere
outline.answers: Secondary 'destination wedding november'; WeddingsAbroad (New York #1) 'November through to March'; Teach Travel Discover (Sydney #4) 'outside of the hurricane belt'; must-include group 2 in 01-brief
outline.notes: Matches 01-brief group 2. Smartraveller (read 2026-11-26, date 'as at November 2026'): Indonesia wet season usually around October to April; Mauritius cyclone season November to May; Seychelles monsoon season November to March; Fiji on the pacific path. NZ and Fiji November 2025 summaries labelled one year only.

outline.answers: Gap: no ranking page compares hemisphere, season and legal route side by side
outline.notes: Plain-word table: destination, November season, main trade-off, legal or symbolic for Australians, our guide. No temperatures unless sourced.
